Elena Ortiz: Heads up 111 - after the runtime-6.0.0 rollout we're seeing integrity errors and occasional kernel-load failures for rerank-pro on longer contexts. Affected traffic is concentrated in ap-south and a handful of enterprise tenants. I'm proposing a combined mitigation: tenant-scoped SDK pin + region-scoped runtime fallback while we triage. Any objections?
Markus H.: Can you paste a couple of error samples and the tenant list so we can size the blast radius?
Elena Ortiz: Window 21:48-22:05 UTC. Tenants: acme-enterprise, beta-net, small-co. Samples below (repro locally on a long query):
```
2026-09-09T21:49:12Z tenant=acme-enterprise model=rerank-pro runtime=6.0.0 sdk=6.2 req=id_7b level=error resolver: signature_mismatch expected=(v3) got=(v2)
2026-09-09T21:52:04Z tenant=beta-net model=rerank-pro runtime=6.0.0 host=ap-south-2 req=id_9c level=error kernel: load_fail err="no-compatible-kernel-for-quant-profile"
```
Markus H.: Ok that's enough to act. Prefer minimizing customer impact: tenant-scoped SDK pin (so affected customers resume) + region-scoped runtime pin for the rerank-pro cohort in ap-south. TTL 3h with canary 1% left on other traffic so we still catch edge cases.
release-coordinator-bot: Proposed commands:
`/pin sdk sdk-6.1.0 scope=tenants:acme-enterprise,beta-net,small-co reason="signature-and-kernel-fallback-after-6.0.0" ttl=10800 initiated_by=@Elena Ortiz`
`/pin runtime runtime-5.9.3 scope=region:ap-south models=rerank-pro reason="kernel-incompat-after-6.0.0" ttl=10800 canary=1% initiated_by=@Elena Ortiz`
Elena Ortiz: That looks right. Also request a short change window 22:00-01:00 UTC and notify SRE. We'll only extend pins if telemetry shows sustained errors.
deploybot: Applying pins...
deploybot: Pin applied: PIN-14007 scope=tenants:[acme-enterprise,beta-net,small-co] sdk=6.1.0 ttl=10800s initiated_by=Elena Ortiz. To extend: `/deploybot extend PIN-14007 hours=1`
deploybot: Pin applied: PIN-14008 scope=region:ap-south runtime=5.9.3 models=[rerank-pro] ttl=10800s canary=1% initiated_by=Elena Ortiz. To extend: `/deploybot extend PIN-14008 hours=1`
changelog-bot: Draft changelog created: "2026-09-09: Temporary tenant-scoped SDK pin (PIN-14007) and regional runtime fallback (PIN-14008) for rerank-pro due to signature/kernal-loading issues after runtime-6.0.0." PR: https://git.redwood/release-notes/pins/14007-14008/draft
eng-sre: SRE alerted. Suppressing noisy resolver/kernel alerts for pinned tenants/region; high-sev channel remains open. We'll post telemetry snapshots (signature_mismatch counts, kernel_load_fail counts, p95/p99 latency) every 10m.
Markus H.: Rollback/unpin criteria proposal: signature_mismatch < 1/min and kernel_load_fail < 1/min for 20 continuous minutes AND canary traffic shows no regressions for 15 minutes. If the runtime patch lands sooner we can remove pins early.
Elena Ortiz: Agreed. Also adding operator note to the release PR so CS and PMs aren't surprised. I'll add a short customer-facing blurb and link to the runbook. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/compatibility-pins section "tenant+region combined pin".
deploybot: Monitoring: both pins will auto-unpin when TTL expires unless extended. Events will be posted to #release-ops on unpin/removal.
release-coordinator-bot: Change window opened 22:00-01:00 UTC for the investigation/patch path. Notifying release-ops and on-call.
eng-sre: We'll post first telemetry snapshot at 22:10 UTC and then every 10 minutes. Alert rule: fire if kernel_load_fail > 5/min or signature_mismatch > 10/min across any non-pinned tenant.
Elena Ortiz: Thanks all. Keeping this scoped; if anyone sees similar behavior outside ap-south or different cohorts, call out here and we'll consider expanding the mitigation.
